result.summary: Found 1 notable visual issue: a loading spinner is showing over an image that should already be loaded on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, suggesting the image failed to load or is stuck in a loading state while other images on the page have loaded correctly.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset loads properly, add a timeout/fallback image, and verify the loading state clears once the image is fetched.
